-- Relatório Diário
WITH daily_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_orders,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'approved' THEN 1 END) as approved_orders,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'negotiating' THEN 1 END) as negotiating_orders,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) as cancelled_orders,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'budget_ready' THEN 1 END) as pending_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'approved' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) as total_revenue,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'approved' THEN total_amount END) as avg_ticket,
    COUNT(DISTINCT client_email) as unique_clients
  FROM receitas
  WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURRENT_DATE
),
medication_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    m.name,
    COUNT(*) as quantity,
    SUM(m.total_price) as revenue
  FROM receitas r
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.budget_data->'medications') AS med
  JOIN medicamentos m ON LOWER(m.name) = LOWER(med->>'name')
  WHERE DATE(r.created_at) = CURRENT_DATE
  AND r.status = 'approved'
  GROUP BY m.name
  ORDER BY quantity DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
channel_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    channel,
    COUNT(*) as orders,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'approved' THEN 1 END) as approved,
    ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'approved' THEN 1 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2) as conversion_rate
  FROM receitas
  WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURRENT_DATE
  GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT 
  to_json(daily_stats) as daily_summary,
  json_agg(DISTINCT medication_stats) as top_medications,
  json_agg(DISTINCT channel_stats) as channel_performance
FROM daily_stats, medication_stats, channel_stats;

-- Relatório Semanal
WITH weekly_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_at) as order_date,
    COUNT(*) as total_orders,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'approved' THEN 1 END) as approved,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'approved' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) as revenue
  FROM receitas
  WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_at)
  ORDER BY order_date
),
week_summary AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(total_orders) as total_orders,
    SUM(approved) as total_approved,
    SUM(revenue) as total_revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(revenue), 2) as avg_daily_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(approved)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(total_orders), 0) * 100, 2) as conversion_rate
  FROM weekly_stats
),
client_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT client_email) as total_clients,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN client_email END) as returning_clients
  FROM (
    SELECT client_email, COUNT(*) as order_count
    FROM receitas
    WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
    GROUP BY client_email
  ) client_orders
),
product_performance AS (
  SELECT 
    m.name as medication,
    COUNT(*) as times_ordered,
    SUM((med->>'quantity')::int) as total_quantity,
    SUM((med->>'total')::numeric) as total_revenue,
    ROUND(AVG((med->>'unit_price')::numeric), 2) as avg_price
  FROM receitas r
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.budget_data->'medications') AS med
  JOIN medicamentos m ON LOWER(m.name) = LOWER(med->>'name')
  WHERE r.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND r.status = 'approved'
  GROUP BY m.name
  ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
  LIMIT 20
)
SELECT
  to_json(week_summary) as weekly_summary,
  json_agg(DISTINCT weekly_stats ORDER BY weekly_stats.order_date) as daily_breakdown,
  to_json(client_stats) as client_metrics,
  json_agg(DISTINCT product_performance) as product_performance
FROM week_summary, weekly_stats, client_stats, product_performance
GROUP BY week_summary, client_stats;
